reason: Conversation 1 went straight to the sensible first step (seal inspection plus paper test), asked for the model number and ice location up front, and reached the correct diagnosis in two turns with concrete, honest part-ordering advice (model/service number, freezer-specific seal) and a safe push-in fitting procedure including defrosting first. Conversation 2 wrongly anchored on a blocked defrost drain for a static manual-defrost freezer, needed five turns to reach the same conclusion, included an irrelevant 'fridge not cooling' image, and even after the seal was confirmed kept the drain theory alive as a next suspect, which is an unsupported direction. Conversation 2's point about bonded seals and checking door alignment was a fair addition, but it does not offset the slower, partly misdirected diagnosis.
